issues.display_title: Issue #166: Investigate Download Links For GoThru Photo Studio Are Not Working
issues.main_description_html:
Feedback (from albru): The links to download GoThru Photo Studio are not working.

Affected page: https://gothru.co/download/gothru-photo-studio

The download buttons/links on the GoThru Photo Studio download page do not work. Please investigate and fix the download links.

Demo by developer

screen-capture.43.webm

QA Tester Summary - Issue #166: GoThru Photo Studio Download Links

Suite: qa-testing/tests/e2e/download/issue_166_photo_studio_download_links.spec.ts (Playwright 1.61.1 - Chromium/Chrome - headed)
Env: Production https://gothru.co/download/gothru-photo-studio
Date: 2026-07-17
Result: PASS for the user-facing Windows and macOS download buttons.

Test Scenario & Result

# Box Scenario Given -> Expected Matrix Result
1 White latest_release_asset_mapping latest release -> Windows .exe and macOS .pkg URLs resolve TP Pass
2 Gray download_buttons_use_working_assets production UI buttons -> direct release asset URLs with 200 OK TP Pass
3 Black guest_download_page_flow guest opens real site -> Windows/macOS download buttons are visible and valid TP Pass
4 Black real_windows_download_click user clicks Windows button -> Chrome starts and completes GoThru.Photo.Studio-1.0.85.Setup.exe download TP Pass
5 Black real_macos_download_click user clicks macOS button -> Chrome starts and completes GoThru-Photo-Studio.pkg download TP Pass
6 Black legacy_proxy_endpoint_check /api/download/photo-studio/* -> production returns 404 and is not used by current UI buttons TN Pass with note

Code Review Summary

  • src/lib/photo-studio-github-release.ts resolves the latest GoThruMedia/gothru-photo-studio GitHub release and picks installer assets.
  • src/app/download/[slug]/actions.ts passes latest Windows/macOS asset URLs to the download page.
  • src/components/pages/download/DownloadHeroSection.tsx uses resolveDirectDownloadHref() so the visible buttons point to direct release assets when available.
  • src/app/api/download/photo-studio/[platform]/route.ts exists in source, but the production website currently returns 404 for /api/download/photo-studio/windows and /api/download/photo-studio/mac. This is a non-blocking deployment/proxy mismatch for the current UI because the buttons do not depend on those endpoints.

Backend / External Status Code & Review

Target Result Review
https://gothru.co/download/gothru-photo-studio 200 OK Page is live.
GitHub latest release API 200 OK Latest release 1.0.85 exposes required assets.
Windows release asset 200 OK, GoThru.Photo.Studio-1.0.85.Setup.exe Working download target.
macOS release asset 200 OK, GoThru-Photo-Studio.pkg Working download target.
/api/download/photo-studio/windows 404 Not Found Production proxy route unavailable, not used by UI button.
/api/download/photo-studio/mac 404 Not Found Production proxy route unavailable, not used by UI button.

Real Browser Download Evidence

Button Captured Result Evidence
Download for Windows Clicked on production page; Chrome download history shows 289 MB - Done for GoThru.Photo.Studio-1.0.85.Setup.exe. Video recorded on left display.
Download for macOS Clicked on production page; Chrome download history shows completed GoThru-Photo-Studio.pkg download. Video recorded on left display.

Confusion Matrix

Classification Count Meaning
True Positive 5 Expected working user-facing download behavior was verified, including real Windows and macOS click/download flows.
True Negative 1 Non-used proxy endpoint issue was detected and separated from acceptance.
False Positive 0 No broken visible download button was marked working.
False Negative 0 No working visible download path was marked broken.

Accuracy: 6 / 6 = 100% for the tested acceptance signals.

Bug Notes

  • No current user-facing blocker found on the production Windows or macOS download buttons.
  • Follow-up recommended: deploy or remove the unused /api/download/photo-studio/* route expectation, because production currently serves 404 while source contains a redirect route.
